map.A = π·a·b，a 长半轴、b 短半轴。当 a=b 时退化为圆 A=πr²。: A = pi·a·b with a the semi-major and b the semi-minor axis. When a=b it reduces to the circle A=pi·r2. Requires a,b>0.
map.例：a=5m、b=3m → A=π×15=47.1239 m²。若 a=10m、: Example: a=5m, b=3m gives A=pi x 15=47.1239 m2. If a=10m, b=6m (both axes doubled), A=pi x 60=188.4956 m2, which is 4x larger because both semi-axes scale linearly.
map.椭圆面积为何没有单独的“半轴平方”？: Why is there no separate 'semi-axis squared' in the ellipse area?
map.圆的面积是 πr²，椭圆可看作圆在两个方向分别拉伸 a/r 与 b/r 倍，面积: A circle's area is pi·r2, and an ellipse can be seen as a circle stretched by a/r and b/r in two directions, scaling the area by ab/r2; taking r=1 gives pi·a·b. It amounts to multiplying the two semi-axes and then by pi.
map.长轴短轴已知怎么用？: How do I use known major and minor axes?
map.长轴=2a、短轴=2b，先除以 2 得 a、b 再代入；本工具用的是半轴而非全轴: Since the major axis is 2a and the minor axis 2b, divide by 2 to get a and b before substituting; this tool uses semi-axes, not full axis lengths.
